scope: Guarded observed nonconformant SSH identification, initial method/transport field consistency, source attribution, generated PDU references, late Windows rows and bounded detail retention. This is an initial IP/TCP profile, not whole-protocol conformance.

live.identification_emulation: Paramiko test endpoint; no Cisco device claim

wire.scope:
Independently certify selected initial SSH PDUs and role/offer evidence.
Scope: owned IPv4 loopback TCP, original capture or declared replay controls,
initial uncompressed no-MAC packets through each direction's first NEWKEYS.
Encrypted rekey/authentication/application contents, key mathematics, signature
verification and native peer identity are not certified. DecodeAs server ports
are declared reference hints, not native role evidence.

fields.scope:
Independently decode selected clear SSH DH/GEX/ECDH/RSA field layouts.
Use RFC 4253/4419/5656 binary strings and bounded cursors, not a Yak codec.
Compare the entire native initial packet field tree with exact PDU bytes, then
compare selected values with byte/frame-matched Wireshark views. This certifies
framing, values and fingerprints, not DH mathematics, a signature or identity.

wire_role_warning.scope: Challenge initial SSH role/field/byte auditing without rewriting source PCAP.

literal_initial_fields.scope: Challenge the independent initial-field auditor with corrupted projections.

generated_ID_and_recovery.scope:
Challenge exact-message ID mapping and SSH recovery with derived subsets.
Use the original public SSH connection plus one unchanged neighbouring STP PDU.
For metadata controls deliberately rebind only the enclosing file digest so the
per-message byte/field/endpoint proofs and ID bijection, not just the digest gate,
must reject the corruption. Original message proofs are never regenerated.

SDK_invariants.scope:
Constrain public SSH compatibility recovery to one observed connection.
Match every previous PDU by its exact raw bytes, endpoints, capture domain and
physical contributors, then construct a bijection for its generated PDU ID.
Only explicit PDU-reference fields use this bijection; packet numbers, stream
IDs, wire transaction fields, sequences and lengths stay exact. Separately
certified SSH field corrections require an exact-file literal-field certificate.
The added initial messages require a separate independent wire/reference audit.

CLI_invariants.scope:
Check every public CLI row against the guarded SSH recovery SDK export.
Use the separately certified exact-message PDU-ID bijection only for declared
identity/reference metadata. Physical row facts and every other connection stay
exact. New SSH scalar projections must match their exact SDK source evidence.

initial_reference_fields.scope:
Compare native initial SSH fields with literal public-reference PDU views.
Captured domains and byte-contributing frames are preserved. Complete native
messages, reference views, opaque encrypted suffixes and refusal diagnostics
remain separate counts; this does not certify all encrypted SSH contents.

5 method PDUs in the reordered capture retain generic bodies at publication because exchange context was not yet established; later-context derived refinement remains open
The legacy direct stateless application-layer.ssh rule entry still needs a separate review; this certificate covers native GetFields/Decode and the explicit bounded initial-profile decoder
Encrypted SSH rekey, authentication, channels/application content, DH mathematics, signature verification and peer identity are not certified
Reference SSH over non-IP/TCP carriers is listed separately; no native SCTP-SSH claim
Some display-filter field coverage remains explicitly partial; the increased detail budget does not turn unavailable fields into a proof
Other protocol, public fuzz, direct-rule and per-field byte-range gaps remain open; raw display-label equality is not correctness
